class_coverage.interpretation: Only images with at least two expert reference classes contribute to the multiclass image-average scores. Classes with fewer than five expert cells are excluded from the sensitivity score. Single-class images remain visible but have no multiclass score. The score is conditional on expert nuclear masks, and does not assess cell detection.

scope: Conditional cell typing at expert nuclei, with a 3 µm nucleus-anchored cell proxy. Virtual markers are uncalibrated predictions.

native_nuclear_qc.interpretation_limit: Agreement with H&E-derived nuclei does not establish measured DAPI accuracy. A poor StarDist mask can also lower this score. Inspect the overlay and mask.
